{"id": 146987, "name": "Bring Me The Horizon", "description": "Bring Me the Horizon is one of the most influential and genre-
defining rock bands of the 21st century. Formed in Sheffield,
England, the group has built a global following by continuously
evolving their sound— blending metalcore roots with alternative
rock, electronic, pop, and experimental elements.
The band reached new global heights with critically acclaimed
albums including That's the Spirit, Amo, and Post Human: Survival
Horror, producing massive streaming hits like “Can You Feel My
Heart”, “Drown”, and “Throne.” Known for their boundary-pushing
creativity, immersive visuals, and explosive live performances,
Bring Me the Horizon have become one of modern rock’s most
innovative forces.
With billions of global streams, arena-level touring worldwide,
and a constantly expanding creative universe, Bring Me the
Horizon continue to redefine the possibilities of modern heavy
music for a new generation of fans."

{"id": 147005, "name": "Odd Future", "description": "Odd Future are a raucous hip hop collective hailing from Los Angeles, CA.
